title: Outlook / OWA / Exchange Client Connectivity Troubleshooting Toolkit
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (enterprise Exchange/M365 messaging operations).

Exchange admin center / M365 admin center / Exchange Online PowerShell (EXO V3) / Microsoft Graph and on-prem Exchange Server + AD authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; version-/plan-dependent behavior (Exchange Server CU, EOP vs Defender for Office 365 plan, EOA/auto-expanding archive availability, Commercial vs Government cloud) cited or flagged 'verify in your tenant/version', never invented. Third-party hygiene/archiving/gateway tools at the pattern level. Automation is PowerShell (EXO PowerShell / Graph) — no hardcoded credentials or secrets in code. No client names.
hook: Diagnose and fix Outlook, OWA, and mobile mail connectivity fast
problem: “Outlook won't connect” is one of the highest-volume messaging tickets — and without a method it's guesswork. This solution is a layered client-connectivity troubleshooting toolkit for Exchange Online / hybrid: Autodiscover flow, MAPI-over-HTTP / EWS / ActiveSync endpoints, authentication (modern auth, conditional access), profile and cached-mode issues, OWA, and mobile — a decision tree from symptom to root cause with the exact tests (Test-* cmdlets, Remote Connectivity Analyzer, message headers) — so client issues resolve on first contact.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the client-connectivity model: Autodiscover, protocol endpoints (MAPI/HTTP, EWS, ActiveSync, OWA), modern auth / conditional access, and the layered diagnostic method.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (EXO/hybrid, DNS/Autodiscover, admin + test accounts, EXO PowerShell / RCA access).
Diagnostic Playbook — a symptom→root-cause decision tree (can't set up profile, disconnects, auth loops, free/busy, OWA/mobile) with the exact tests and remediations at each node — each check named.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Exchange Online PowerShell (EXO V3) / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (Autodiscover resolves, protocols connect, auth succeeds) plus Best Practices for reducing client-connectivity ticket volume.
short: A layered Outlook/OWA/Exchange client-connectivity troubleshooting toolkit — Autodiscover, MAPI/HTTP/EWS/ActiveSync, modern auth/CA, profiles, OWA and mobile — a symptom-to-root-cause decision tree with exact tests, so client issues resolve on first contact. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
